text: Maintaining grid reliability is a core design requirement for Oracle's large-scale data center facilities. Low Voltage Ride Through and load oscillation smoothing capabilities are important for maintaining grid stability and we're proud to be leading the industry in developing technologies that help us use grid power responsibly. Oracle and its partners have worked extensively with Lancium and utility providers to engineer solutions that comply with the applicable grid standards and support reliable grid operations. Protecting grid infrastructure and supporting system stability have been key considerations throughout our data center design and deployment process.
